# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Common Git Worktree Issues

### Unsticking a jammed worktree

If a worktree is stuck (e.g., after an interrupted operation or a process that held a lock), follow this procedure to unstick it without rediscovering the solution:

```bash
# 1. Check what is locked
git status

# 2. Find and examine the lock file
lsof | grep index.lock

# 3. Kill the process holding the lock
kill -9 <PID>

# 4. Remove the stale worktree entry
git worktree prune
```

This resolves index.lock contention and clears stale worktree references that can cause "the directory is already managed by git" errors.
